To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
femtosecond-laser irradiation of plasmonic nanoparticles embedded in a polymer matrix can be used for the photoinduced alteration of the material.

(1) plasmonic nanoparticles can be used to initiate a photochemical reaction, which can be used for the material alteration, (2) the photochemical reaction is initiated near the plasmonics nanoparticles, and (3) the photochemical reactions can change the symmetry of the initially isotropic medium.
the plasmonic nano-particles inserted into the bulk polymer matrix provide a unique opportunity for material alteration by femtosec laser light.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the possibility of controlling the spatial distribution of products of chemical reactions in the bulk of a material, which can be used for the fabrication of new functional materials with a predetermined structure.
the possibility of creating new functional materials based on plasmonic nanoparticles embedded in a polymer matrix and irradiated by laser pulses.
the opportunities provided by plasmonic nanoparticles for the photo-induced alteration of the bulk properties of a material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the plasmonic particles can be used to control the spatial and temporal distribution of the products formed by photochemical reactions and the spatial distribution of heat generated by the absorption of the laser light by the plasmonics nanoparticles.
the plasmonic nano-particles in a transparent medium can be used to modify the optical properties of the material and the material itself.
the plasmonic metal nanoparticles in the transparent polymer matrix are an effective tool for the alteration of material properties by the light irradiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasmonic nanostructures inserted into a matrix can be used for the control of the photochemical reactions in the matrix.
the plasmonic nano-composite material can be used to control the spatial distribution of chemical reactions in a transparent medium, which may be used to create new materials with desired properties.
the plasmonic nano-particle can be considered as a local light source, and the material alteration can be controlled by the spatial distribution of this light source in the material.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the material alteration by laser light is not only determined by the properties of the irradiated domain, but also by the surrounding material.
both the photochemical and photo-thermal reactions are enhanced by the plasmonics.
plasmonic nanoparticles in the polymer matrix can be used to create the material with a spatially modulated symmetry, which can be used to design new materials with unique properties.
